diagnosis: Assessment of Ki-67 proliferation index in endocrine and neuroendocrine neoplasms
legend: Eyeballing for Ki-67 proliferation index is not considered to be accurate. Pathologists should perform a formal manual count or use an automated image analysis nuclear algorithm. This image illustrates a manual count on a metastatic grade 2 (G2) neuroendocrine tumour (NET) in the liver.

diagnosis: Assessment of Ki-67 proliferation index in endocrine and neuroendocrine neoplasms
legend: Eyeballing for Ki-67 proliferation index is not considered to be accurate. Pathologists should perform a formal manual count or use an automated image analysis nuclear algorithm. This image illustrates the assessment of a parathyroid carcinoma using a different automated image analysis nuclear algorithm to that shown in Fig. <<28852>>. The methodology used to assess the Ki-67 proliferation index should be clearly defined in pathology reports.
